meta.name: add-ollama-tool
meta.description: Add Ollama MCP server so the container agent can call local models and optionally manage the Ollama model library.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中运行本地大模型并管理模型库
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local models and manage model library
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to run local LLMs in containers and manage model libraries

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 可以调用你电脑上本地运行的 Ollama 模型来回答问题或生成内容,并能查看本机已安装的模型列表;如果开启了管理选项,还能帮你下载、删除模型,以及查看当前正在运行的模型。
howto.when: 当用户要求给容器代理添加 Ollama 本地模型支持(如“接入 Ollama”“让 Claude 调用本地模型”)时,技能会进行安装和配置。完成后,用户提出相关请求时会调用这些工具。

say.text: 用 Ollama 告诉我法国的首都是什么?
say.note: agent 会先列出模型,再用生成工具回答。
需要已启用管理工具,会调用拉取接口。

say.text: 哪些 Ollama 模型正在内存中运行?
say.note: 会列出当前加载的模型及内存占用。

howto.what_en: When this skill is applied, Claude gains access to local Ollama models through an MCP server. It can list installed models and generate responses using them. If the admin flag is enabled, it can also pull, delete, show, and list running models.
howto.when_en: The skill runs when a user asks to integrate local Ollama models into the container agent. Once configured, the agent will use the Ollama tools when the user makes requests like 'use ollama to answer...'.

say_en.text: Use Ollama to tell me the capital of France.
say_en.note: Agent lists models, then generates an answer.

say_en.text: Which Ollama models are loaded in memory?
say_en.note: Lists running models with memory usage.
